actual interface and manufacturing constraints

steps.what: Create mechanical design documents for parts, assemblies or finished products in mechanical CAD/document control (OPS_SYSTEM), including actual views, dimensions and annotations
inputs: engineer-selected drawing scope and verified model revision
engineer-authored dimensions, tolerances, material and manufacturing notes

steps.what: Check the complete mechanical design documents against model, requirements, tolerances, interfaces and intended controlled record
inputs: complete mechanical design document draft
actual requirements and verified model revision

tasks.design: Configure native drawing templates, standard view placement and revision-linked title fields in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the mechanical CAD/document-control system. The engineer supplies design intent, dimensions and tolerances, checks the complete document and saves its exact internal draft revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated drawing layout and fixed title-field work consumes document-authoring time.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing CAD templates and linked model properties can handle repeated formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Design intent, manufacturability, tolerances and interface correctness require engineering checks.
tasks.human_edge: Choose what the drawing must communicate and resolve ambiguity.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0.5-1; CAD owner authorizes template and property access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: mechanical CAD templates and linked model properties can reduce repeated drawing layout while engineering checks remain necessary.

assumptions: Unmeasured repeated-drawing scenario. Gross 50 x .20 = 10; upkeep 2; net 8 hours per 100.
Engineer supplies and checks the actual model, property values, dimensions and annotations in s1-s3. Missing properties are manually authored, not inferred.
Existing CAD projection and calculation functions already used today earn no saving; benefit applies only to currently repeated layout and fixed-field work.
Save is a same-system action with 1 fully retained point, approximately zero today and no saving. This is an internal draft, with no manufacturing release or supplier send promised.
Final completed-document check s3 gates the exact revision and destination; edits void the check.
unknowns: How much current layout is already templated
research_questions: Which repeated drawing operations remain manual after existing CAD configuration?

already_counted.description: Engineering scope and complete document verification

incremental.description: Maintain drawing templates and spot-check model property mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed design documents, revision and destination checked in s3; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 repeated-layout scenario below 8% modeled net; zero when templates already cover the work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

inputs: actual intended application and operating conditions
actual accuracy, range and control requirements
outputs: engineer-defined equipment requirements and acceptance criteria

steps.what: Design advanced precision equipment for accurate or controlled applications, selecting mechanical, sensing and control arrangements
inputs: engineer-defined equipment requirements and acceptance criteria
actual component characteristics and interface constraints
outputs: engineer-designed equipment concept and justified component choices

steps.what: Build and check the actual precision-equipment model, tolerance analysis and control assumptions in engineering CAD/analysis software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: engineer-designed equipment concept and justified component choices
engineer-entered dimensions, tolerances, loads and model assumptions
outputs: exact checked equipment model, analysis and internal revision destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked precision-equipment design and analysis as an internal revision
inputs: exact checked equipment model, analysis and internal revision destination

tasks.design: Configure reusable, engineer-validated component and analysis setup profiles in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the engineering CAD/analysis system. The engineer defines the application, chooses the equipment architecture, enters actual parameters and checks the completed model before saving the internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated component and analysis setup can distract from precision design decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable assemblies and analysis profiles can reduce repeated setup.
tasks.still_hard: Error budgets, dynamic response and physical assumptions determine whether precision is achievable.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a defensible equipment design and recognise invalid model assumptions.

ambition.what: No claim of newly achievable accuracy or automatic equipment release.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; engineering owner validates reusable profiles and component access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reusable native engineering setup profiles can reduce repeated setup without replacing precision-system design or validation.

assumptions: Unmeasured repeated-setup scenario. Gross 29 x .10 = 2.9; upkeep 1; net 1.9 hours per 100.
Engineer produces parameters and assumptions in s1-s3; no free structured error budget, missing load or component certification is assumed.
Existing solver execution and existing reusable models are already today's means. Only additional repeated setup reuse earns saving; novel equipment may have none.
Save 1 is fully retained, approximately zero today and earns no saving. Final design/model check s3 gates the exact version; no build or commissioning action is included.
unknowns: Reusable setup fraction for genuinely novel equipment
research_questions: Which recurring model setup survives application-specific parameter and assumption checks?

already_counted.description: Design choices and completed model/analysis entry and verification

incremental.description: Maintain and revalidate reusable component/analysis profiles

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed precision design, assumptions and destination checked in s3; edits invalidate check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 native setup scenario below modeled 1.9% net; no solver-runtime or engineering-judgment benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design systems for industrial task automation

steps.what: Study the actual industrial task, existing equipment, operator interactions and operating constraints
inputs: actual industrial work and existing equipment
operator and maintenance accounts of constraints and exceptions
outputs: engineer's observed industrial task and automation requirements

steps.what: Design engineering systems for the automation of industrial tasks, choosing architecture, operator interaction and fault responses
inputs: engineer's observed industrial task and automation requirements
actual equipment interfaces and operating limits
outputs: engineer-selected automation architecture, interfaces and fault responses

steps.what: Author and check automation-system schematics, interface definitions and design description in control-engineering design software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: engineer-selected automation architecture, interfaces and fault responses
actual component identifiers and engineer-authored interface definitions
outputs: exact complete checked automation-system design and internal record destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked automation-system design as the intended internal design revision
inputs: exact complete checked automation-system design and internal record destination

tasks.design: Configure native schematic symbols and fixed component/interface property reuse in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the control-engineering design system. The engineer studies the actual task, designs the architecture and fault responses, then authors and checks the final design before saving its internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated symbols and fixed component properties add drafting effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native component libraries and linked properties can reduce repeated drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Industrial exceptions, operator interactions and fault behavior require engineering design.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the real task and choose where automation is appropriate.

ambition.what: No unattended commissioning or autonomous control deployment.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; controls owner validates component library and access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: control-engineering design libraries can reduce repeated schematic authoring while the engineer designs and checks behavior.

assumptions: Unmeasured drafting scenario. Gross 29 x .10 = 2.9; upkeep 1; net 1.9 hours per 100.
Engineer produces actual task requirements, interface definitions and behavior in s1-s3; libraries do not infer safe machine behavior or missing equipment facts.
Only repeated drafting changes; existing control software, calculators and simulation runtime earn no additional saving.

Same-system save is 1 fully retained point, approximately zero today with no saving. Final check s3 gates exact internal revision; no controller download, machine change or operational release is promised.
unknowns: Existing symbol reuse and actual drafting burden
research_questions: Which fixed component properties are still manually copied after current native library use?

already_counted.description: Task study, design and completed design authoring/check

incremental.description: Maintain native symbols/property mappings and test changed library entries

approvals.approved_version: Exact final automation-system design and internal revision destination checked in s3; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 repeated-drafting scenario below 1.9% modeled net; no design-decision benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare and check the exact mechatronic design test configuration, procedure, limits and lab conditions before energising
inputs: actual design revision and test objectives
actual lab equipment condition, test procedure and authorised operating limits
outputs: checked exact test configuration, procedure and readiness to energise

steps.what: Energise and establish the checked exact design test setup within authorised lab limits
inputs: checked exact test configuration, procedure and readiness to energise

steps.what: Test the design solution, observe physical responses, execute prescribed measurements and stop or adjust safely when needed
inputs: energised actual design test setup
actual procedure, observed responses and instrument readings
outputs: actual test measurements and engineer's observations

steps.what: Load actual instrument exports, check units and test identity, and calculate results in laboratory test analysis software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual test measurements and engineer's observations
actual instrument-export schema, units and run identifiers
outputs: engineer-checked test result calculations linked to actual run

steps.what: Interpret the test results and enter and check the complete design-test record, limitations and actual run identity
inputs: engineer-checked test result calculations linked to actual run
actual observations, acceptance criteria and design revision
outputs: exact checked final test record and intended internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked design-test record to its intended internal run record
inputs: exact checked final test record and intended internal destination

tasks.design: For the test branch of this task, configure native instrument-export import and calculation profiles in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the laboratory test analysis system. The engineer checks and energises the actual setup, conducts the physical test, validates imported results and writes/checks the final record before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated import setup and result-table handling add effort after physical testing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native laboratory analysis profiles can reuse an already known instrument schema and calculation setup.
tasks.still_hard: Physical readiness, unusual responses and interpretation remain engineering responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the setup or results invalidate the intended test.

ambition.what: No autonomous test energisation or production deployment.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; lab owner validates test limits, export access and profiles

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native laboratory analysis imports can reduce repeated result handling, with physical testing and result interpretation retained.

assumptions: Unmeasured lab-test episode, the statement's test alternative rather than claiming implementation is free. Gross 15 x .20 = 3; upkeep 1; net 2 hours per 100.

Engineer produces actual measurements in s3, loads and reconciles them in s4. Missing exports or schema changes require manual handling; no new instrument integration or structured observations assumed free.
Existing automated measurement and solver execution already happen today and earn no saving. Only repeated import/calculation setup changes.

Actual energising has positive fully retained labour, distinct from the nearly zero same-system save (1 fully retained point, no saving). Final setup/readiness s1 gates exact s2 configuration; any setup or conditions change requires renewed checking.
Final record authoring/check s5 gates s6; edits invalidate it. No production release or external report transmission is included.
unknowns: Actual repeated result-handling effort and schema stability
research_questions: Can a native import profile reproduce the current engineer-checked results without hiding schema or unit errors?

Exact completed test record and destination checked in s5; edits require recheck
